The '''Karsoom''' was a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] operating on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Karsoom mercenaries appear in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as enemies on Nar Shaddaa.
